left.raw_text: Current inpatient hospitalization or active suicidal ideation requiring referral for inpatient hospitalization for safety.
History of psychotic disorder or manic episode diagnosed by MINI-KID
History of substance dependence diagnosis by MINI-KID (excluding tobacco) or positive urine toxicology.
Pregnancy (urine pregnancy tests on the day of scans for menstruating girls).

AND.raw_text: Inability to provide written informed consent according to the Yale Human Investigation Committee (HIC) guidelines in English.
